verdict.rationale: Firecrawl is an HTTP API service, so publishing an OpenAPI spec is a fair question. The pack has no evidence of a downloadable spec, and the probe found every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt documentation index is an adjacent docs feature, not a machine-readable API specification, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
